for k in range(len(u)):
    y[k + 1] = 0.8 * y[k] + 0.2 * u[k]
Phi = np.column_stack((y[:-1], u))

notebooks.title: 同先验RLS与加权批量目标逐步核对
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
u = np.array([1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0], dtype=float)
y = np.zeros(len(u) + 1)
for k in range(len(u)):
    y[k + 1] = 0.8 * y[k] + 0.2 * u[k]
Phi = np.column_stack((y[:-1], u))
target = y[1:]

cells.code:
paths = {}
for lam in [1.0, 0.9]:
    theta = np.zeros(2)
    P = np.eye(2)
    path = []
    for n, (phi, value) in enumerate(zip(Phi, target), start=1):
        denominator = lam + phi @ P @ phi
        assert np.isfinite(denominator) and denominator > 0
        K = P @ phi / denominator
        theta = theta + K * (value - phi @ theta)
        P = (P - np.outer(K, phi) @ P) / lam
        weights = lam ** np.arange(n - 1, -1, -1)
        augmented = np.vstack((np.sqrt(lam ** n) * np.eye(2), np.sqrt(weights)[:, None] * Phi[:n]))
        rhs = np.concatenate((np.zeros(2), np.sqrt(weights) * target[:n]))
        batch, _, batch_rank, _ = np.linalg.lstsq(augmented, rhs, rcond=None)
        assert batch_rank == 2
        assert np.allclose(theta, batch, atol=1e-12, rtol=0)
        assert np.linalg.eigvalsh((P + P.T) / 2).min() > 0
        path.append((theta.copy(), P.copy(), batch.copy()))
    paths[lam] = path
    print('same_prior_lambda', lam, 'theta', np.round(theta, 6).tolist())
assert np.allclose(paths[1.0][-1][0], [0.3422717040492354, 0.23176593788289176], atol=1e-12, rtol=0)
print('all_prefixes_same_prior_match', True)

notebooks.title: 无激励、测量误差与两个分母

cells.code:
scalar_P = 1.0
scalar_b = 0.0
scalar_path = []
for n in range(32):
    phi = [1, 0, 1, 1][n % 4]
    value = 0.2 * phi
    gain = scalar_P * phi / (1 + phi * scalar_P * phi)
    scalar_b += gain * (value - phi * scalar_b)
    scalar_P = scalar_P - gain * phi * scalar_P
    scalar_path.append((scalar_b, scalar_P))
assert abs(scalar_b - 0.192) < 1e-12 and abs(scalar_P - 0.04) < 1e-12
print('explorer_default_b_P', round(scalar_b, 6), round(scalar_P, 6))

P = 1.0
estimate = 0.0
for n in range(32):
    phi = 0.0
    denominator = 0.9 + phi * P * phi
    K = P * phi / denominator
    estimate += K * (0.0 - phi * estimate)
    P = (P - K * phi * P) / 0.9
assert estimate == 0 and abs(P - 0.9 ** (-32)) < 1e-10
pairs = [(v, w) for v in [-0.1, 0.1] for w in [-0.1, 0.1]]
covariance = np.mean([v * (w - 0.8 * v) for v, w in pairs])
assert abs(covariance + 0.008) < 1e-12
assert denominator > 0 and estimate == 0
print('no_input_estimate', estimate, 'P_growth', round(P, 6))
print('measurement_error_covariance', round(float(covariance), 6))
print('RLS_denominator_positive', True, 'control_inverse_defined', False)
